title: Chefchaouen Travel Guide – Morocco's Blue City
description: Everything you need to know before visiting Chefchaouen: best time to go, top attractions, local tips, and hidden gems.
content:
## Why Visit Chefchaouen?

Chefchaouen, nestled in the Rif Mountains, is famous for its blue-washed medina...

## Best Time to Visit

Spring (March-May) and autumn (September-November) offer mild weather...

## Top Experiences

1. Wander the blue alleyways
2. Hike to the Spanish Mosque for sunset
3. Visit Ras El-Maa waterfall

## Local Tips

- Wear comfortable walking shoes – the medina is hilly
- Try the local goat cheese
- Learn a few Darija words to connect with locals
